prompts.initial_flowering: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one production game plant sprite, Flowering stage of Sunflower for Anki Garden. The referenced image is the anatomy/identity reference, not a background. Repaint this sunflower as polished warm storybook gouache that belongs in a calm painted cottage garden: tactile matte pigment, softly irregular painted edges, broad clear value groups, botanical sage and olive greens with cool teal shadow planes, warm golden yellow petals with restrained amber highlights. Remove the reference's glossy plastic finish, harsh white highlights, excessively engraved leaf veins and dense photographic seed texture. Preserve the species and single-stem upright silhouette. One large open sunflower facing almost forward with a subtly tilted dark umber seed disk, broad overlapping yellow petals; one closed green bud on a short branch at upper right, and six well separated broad heart-shaped leaves along a sturdy tapering green stem. Leaf veins should be simple and painterly. Keep the lowest foliage clear of the stem tip, with no cut cross-section. Slight organic asymmetry, gentle three-quarter botanical volume, not a flat pictogram. The broad main flower is the focal point and occupies roughly 35 percent of the total plant height. Whole plant from tallest petal to soil-contact stem tip visible and uncut, centered contact at x=50%, y=93%; leave generous fully transparent margin on every side, no isolated flecks. Authored gentle upper-right warm illumination and quiet cool fill only, so a scene renderer can relight it. No glow for this stage. No ground, soil mound, planter, scenery, cast shadow, halo, outlines, text, label, watermark, vignette, background color or checkerboard. Output a single high quality square 2048 by 2048 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background. The subject itself must have opaque interiors and clean antialiased edges. This sprite will be seen at 28 to 136 pixels as an icon and about 170 pixels tall in the scene, so preserve strong simple shapes and a clearly visible bud.
prompts.refined_flowering: Edit this newly painted Flowering sunflower into a clean production sprite. Keep its exact plant anatomy, broad petal shapes, single open bloom and one closed side bud, six leaves and painterly texture. Make these specific corrections only: remove every neon green/yellow fringe, stray bright pixel and colored halo along the outer silhouette and in the leaf/stem gaps; the edge must transition cleanly from the local object color to transparent alpha, with no green screen residue. Reduce overall saturation about 15 percent, especially the foliage: use calm deep sage green with blue-green shadow planes and subdued olive highlights. No fluorescent lime, no yellow patchwork across the leaves, no plasticky white speculars. Paint softly grouped matte gouache values with just three simple vein strokes per leaf. Retain warm golden yellow petals and the brown seed disk. Preserve all leaf and petal interiors as opaque. Use fully transparent background, no checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground shadow or scenery. Center the whole plant with all tips visible and a generous 6 percent transparent border around the artwork. Clean professional warm storybook game art that is legible at small icon sizes. Deliver one square transparent PNG.

prompts.initial_young: Create a transparent-background game sprite of a YOUNG SUNFLOWER, before any flower buds develop. One healthy stout green stem with three tiers of broad heart-shaped green leaves and a small folded pair at the growing tip. The juvenile silhouette is approximately twice as tall as wide, full and sturdy, with open gaps between its leaves. Warm storybook gouache illustration for a cozy cottage garden game, matte hand-painted pigment, soft organic edge, deep sage-green leaves with restrained olive highlights and cool teal shadows, simple leaf veins, no photorealistic gloss. Sunlight is gentle upper-right. Include the whole plant down to its tapered stem soil contact, centered in a square image, with plenty of transparent space around it. This is an isolated sprite cutout for direct compositing. Background must be fully transparent alpha. No ground, no soil patch, no planter, no shadow, no flowers, no sparkles, no decorative frame or lettering. Large simple shapes that stay legible as a 28-pixel thumbnail.

Remove the neon lime outline and scattered bright edge flecks, keep shapes healthy and painterly, no plastic shine or fine etched texture. The stem should remain continuous, stout and gently tapered at its lower soil-contact end. Produce one whole-plant sprite centered with clear margins. Plain transparent background, no ground, no roots, no shadows or added props.

user_requested_revisions.prompt: Create a replacement SEED-stage Sunflower game sprite. Image 1 is the current seed artwork; Image 2 shows the garden planter where the sprite must sit. The user dislikes that the whole seed appears to float or rest on top of the soil. Redesign it so it reads unmistakably as PARTLY BURIED: show only the upper roughly HALF of a single charcoal-gray sunflower seed shell protruding diagonally upward out of the planting line. Its pointed tip faces upper-right at about 40 degrees, with two or three warm ivory longitudinal stripes. The entire lower half is below the soil and therefore is NOT drawn. Remove the curling pale root and remove the green shoot completely. Across the low, slightly ragged soil-entry edge, paint a very thin close-fitting overlap of damp dark umber earth, with just three or four tiny attached crumbs. This material occludes the lower shell contour and should blend into the brown soil in Image 2. Keep the earth overlap small and darker than the shell; do not create a mound, oval soil island, puddle, pot, ground slab, or large baked shadow. The result should have a low stable silhouette with the burial line directly under the shell, never a fully outlined free-floating seed. Match the existing warm matte storybook gouache style, subtle soft upper-right light, broad clear painted values, gently textured charcoal shell, readable stripes, no gloss or white outline. One isolated sprite only, centered on a SQUARE canvas with generous empty margins, on a genuine transparent alpha background. No scenery or planter in the output. No checkerboard, text, frame, extra seeds, leaves, sprouts, visible roots, radiating glow or ground shadow. This is a seed stage, not a seedling. Design clear shapes that remain legible in a 28px icon and roughly 24px high in the garden. Keep all material opaque with a clean antialiased boundary and fully transparent surroundings.
